method: Real Plasma Electron app (built from this repo, out/), launched with Playwright _electron at device scale factor 2, window 1440x900 CSS px, isolated empty userData, light appearance, default Plasma coral palette. Illustrative data: fictional shop (Postgres 16.2 throwaway cluster, Redis 7.2.5, OpenSearch 2.17.1). Screenshots are PNG window captures converted to WebP quality 92; dialogs cropped where noted; no editing or recolouring.

pg-workbench.webp.shows: Postgres workbench: the orders table in the data grid, sidebar listing the shop tables, row 13 selected so the Details panel shows its fields (status shown with its enum type name, order_status), connected status capsule on top.
pg-workbench.webp.capture: Full window, orders table opened by double-click in the sidebar, right sidebar shown, one cell clicked. Retaken after the enum type-name fix, from a rebuilt app and a freshly seeded throwaway database.

pg-editor.webp.shows: SQL editor with a three-statement script (revenue by country JOIN/aggregate, best sellers, status counts), run with Run all statements; result tabs Result 1-3 shown.
pg-editor.webp.capture: Script pasted into the query tab, executed via command palette 'Run all statements', Result 1 tab selected.

pg-structure.webp.shows: Structure view of the orders table with one staged change (a column comment on total) and the Preview SQL panel showing the generated BEGIN/COMMENT ON COLUMN/COMMIT.
pg-structure.webp.capture: Orders tab > Structure, typed into the Comment field of column total and blurred; change was never applied.

pg-er.webp.shows: ER diagram of the public schema (customers, products, orders, order_items, payments) with foreign-key relationships, fitted.
pg-er.webp.capture: Command palette 'Show diagram', then Fit to screen; right sidebar hidden.

pg-import.webp.shows: Import data dialog on a 48-row CSV (new_customers.csv): existing table public.customers selected, columns mapped, first rows previewed.
pg-import.webp.capture: File chosen by stubbing the native open dialog to return /tmp/new_customers.csv; Existing table > public.customers; signed_up mapped to created_at. Cropped to the dialog plus margin; import was not run.

pg-roles.webp.shows: Roles and privileges dialog with scratch role analyst selected, Table privileges tab showing SELECT grants on customers, order_items, orders, products.
pg-roles.webp.capture: Command palette 'Roles and privileges', analyst selected, Table privileges tab. Cropped to the dialog plus margin.

pg-search.webp.shows: Search in database for 'Okafor': results grouped by table (13 rows in customers, 4 rows in orders notes) with matches highlighted.
pg-search.webp.capture: Command palette 'Search in database', term typed, Enter. Cropped to the dialog plus margin.

pg-split.webp.shows: Split panes: a join query with results on the left, the orders table on the right.
pg-split.webp.capture: Query run in query-1, orders opened, command palette 'Split pane right'; right sidebar hidden.

pg-explain.webp.shows: Query plan with timing (EXPLAIN ANALYZE) for a join/aggregate: Sort > Aggregate > Hash Join > Seq Scans, with planning/execution totals.
pg-explain.webp.capture: Run dropdown > Explain > Run with ANALYZE. Cropped to the dialog plus margin.

guard-confirm.webp.shows: Safe mode confirmation 'Run this statement?' shown for DROP TABLE orders; under the default confirm-dangerous level.
guard-confirm.webp.capture: DROP TABLE orders; typed and run via palette, dialog captured and then Cancel clicked (orders still has 1,500 rows). Cropped to the dialog plus margin.

palette.webp.shows: Command palette opened with 'sh' typed: connections (shop, shop-cache, shop-search) and actions with shortcuts, over the orders table.

redis.webp.shows: Redis connection (shop-cache, Redis 7.2.5): key tree in the sidebar (cart, events, leaderboard, rate, session) and a session hash open with its fields, TTL, and Details panel.
redis.webp.capture: Connected via home card, rate/cart groups collapsed, first hash key opened, email field clicked. Full window.

opensearch.webp.shows: OpenSearch connection (shop-search, 2.17.1): products index searched with category:Outdoor AND rating:[4.5 TO *], 27 hits, one document selected in the Details panel.
opensearch.webp.capture: Index > Open search, query_string entered and run, row 3 clicked. Full window.
